facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services held a National Multi-Stakeholder Consultation in Harare on 28 August 2025, then sessions in Bulawayo on 9 September and Masvingo on 11 September 2025, to interrogate and validate the Kadoma Draft of the National AI Strategy 2026-2030, with academia, the private sector, civil society and diaspora representatives among those whose contributions the Ministry credits.
